title: sqlv_render_sql
description: Render one MyBatis mapper statement to SQL with ? placeholders and bound parameters.

xml.description: One mapper XML document. Use documents instead when cross-namespace includes are involved.

documents.description: Several mapper documents (path + text) so namespace-qualified includes resolve across files.

params.description: Parameter values bound to #{...} and ${...}; a JSON object keyed by mapper variable name, or an array for scalar parameters.
